experimental_method: Solutions equilibrated with the atmosphere in a 2-l water-jacketed vessel at constant temperature (4-24 h, over 40 h at 5 C), O2 determined by Winkler titration, results corrected to a standard atmosphere; molality from molarity via density.
uncertainties_stated: Standard errors of the Setschenow-type fits below +/-2.0 umol/kg H2O; at least two measurements per temperature; no per-point uncertainty.

Table 1 water value at 0.57 C (449.4) differs from Table 2 NaCl m=0 at 0.57 C (444.7); printed as is. Table 1 values per kg solution, Tables 2-5 per kg H2O. Temperature scale not stated. Table 5 contains 36.01 C at 1.3243 and 35.37 C at 0.2777 (printed temperature scatter within the nominal 35 C group). Shifting temperatures in Table 2 below 1 C group (0.04-0.84 C).
